mapper.select: SELECT w.data_source_id, w.model_version_id, w.window_start FROM ( SELECT ib.data_source_id, ir.model_version_id, STR_TO_DATE(DATE_FORMAT(ir.completed_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00'), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS window_start FROM inference_request ir JOIN ingest_record r ON r.id=ir.ingest_record_id JOIN ingest_batch ib ON ib.id=r.batch_id WHERE ir.completed_at >= #{since} AND ir.completed_at < #{before} AND ir.model_version_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ib.data_source_id, ir.model_version_id, window_start ) w LEFT JOIN drift_metric_window dw ON dw.data_source_id=w.data_source_id AND dw.model_version_id=w.model_version_id AND dw.window_start=w.window_start WHERE dw.id IS NULL ORDER BY w.window_start, w.data_source_id, w.model_version_id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT ir.status, COUNT(*) n FROM inference_request ir JOIN ingest_record r ON r.id=ir.ingest_record_id JOIN ingest_batch ib ON ib.id=r.batch_id WHERE ib.data_source_id=#{sourceId} AND ir.model_version_id=#{modelId} AND ir.completed_at >= #{from} AND ir.completed_at < #{to} GROUP BY ir.status

SELECT ir.id, CAST(JSON_EXTRACT(r.normalized_payload, '$.features') AS CHAR) features, ir.attack_probability, ir.binary_label FROM inference_request ir JOIN ingest_record r ON r.id=ir.ingest_record_id JOIN ingest_batch ib ON ib.id=r.batch_id WHERE ib.data_source_id=#{sourceId} AND ir.model_version_id=#{modelId} AND ir.status='succeeded' AND ir.completed_at >= #{from} AND ir.completed_at < #{to} AND ir.id > #{afterId} ORDER BY ir.id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(*) alerts, COALESCE(SUM(fs.id IS NOT NULL), 0) labeled, COALESCE(SUM(fs.label='false_positive'), 0) false_positive, COALESCE(SUM(fs.label='true_positive'), 0) true_positive FROM detection_alert da JOIN inference_request ir ON ir.id=da.inference_request_id JOIN ingest_record r ON r.id=da.ingest_record_id JOIN ingest_batch ib ON ib.id=r.batch_id LEFT JOIN feedback_sample fs ON fs.active_alert_id=da.id WHERE da.alert_type='model' AND ib.data_source_id=#{sourceId} AND da.model_version_id=#{modelId} AND ir.completed_at >= #{from} AND ir.completed_at < #{to}
SELECT CAST(manifest_json AS CHAR) FROM model_version WHERE id=#{modelId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO drift_metric_window (data_source_id, model_version_id, window_start, window_end, sample_count, request_count, baseline_ref, feature_stats_json, score_stats_json, label_feedback_stats_json, quality_reject_rate, drift_status, computed_by) VALUES (#{dataSourceId}, #{modelVersionId}, #{windowStart}, #{windowEnd}, #{sampleCount}, #{requestCount}, #{baselineRef,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{featureStatsJson}, #{scoreStatsJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{labelFeedbackStatsJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{qualityRejectRate,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{driftStatus}, #{computedBy})
